concepts.name: Wyrm W
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one square mobile app icon concept for WYRMLE, a thoughtful retro daily word-battle game with a friendly little wyrm mascot. Image 1 is a brand/style reference only, not an edit target. Palette: deep olive charcoal #25281f, moss green #93bd74, warm muted gold #e7bd64, tiny terracotta #c77e6c accent if needed. A polished, distinctive icon with a bold readable silhouette at 48 pixels, generous breathing room, clean controlled geometry. Full-bleed opaque square canvas, no surrounding device mockup or exterior frame, no rounded outer-corner mask, no watermark, no caption. Avoid busy details, generic dragon crests, aggressive fantasy art and glossy stock icons. Primary request: a clever monogram: one continuous thick moss-green legless wyrm curls into a clear uppercase W silhouette. Its right terminal is a subtly square friendly head with two tiny dark square eyes and a tiny terracotta forked tongue. Modern confident flat graphic, softly squared bends, charcoal background. The whole wyrm is the W; no separate printed letter, no other text.
